ValidationRule.description: If a CS contact hasn't been added and you try to close win a new business or renewal opp, this triggers
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISCHANGED( StageName ), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed Won"), CS_Contact_Added__c = FALSE,
OR( RecordType.Name = "Renewals", RecordType.Name = "New Business" )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Renewal and New Business records require a CS contact before Close Winning. Ensure an opportunity team member has been assigned with this role
